<function name="ceil" parent="math" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>Ceils or rounds a number up.

	See <page>math.floor</page> for the inverse of this function.</description>
	<realm>Shared and Menu</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="number" type="number">The number to be rounded up.</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="number">ceiled numbers</ret>
	</rets>
</function>

<example>
	<description>Round pi.</description>
	<code>print(math.ceil(math.pi))</code>
	<output>4</output>

</example>
